releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.59 applies the three approved visual refinements without changing app behavior. Home now shows Fahrenheit beside Celsius using the same existing weather reading. Library now has a clear Library title above the existing Library/Inbox content, and the Files summary uses a simpler PDF icon while keeping the same counts and layout. Search, scan, indexing, categories, Notes, Library data, sharing, Settings and all other functions are unchanged.
